tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The named SegmentPrefetch is a test helper: its build method returns a Twitch prefetch tag using the fixture segment URL (tests/plugins/test_twitch.py:161-163). Production prefetch parsing must be distinguished from this fixture class.

checked_claims.claim: Nico HLS enables bidirectional segment event sync
checked_claims.reason: Class stores wsclient; concrete integration is reader-open signal and reader-close client teardown, not generalized segment/event metadata synchronization.

material_errors: Class stores wsclient; concrete integration is reader-open signal and reader-close client teardown, not generalized segment/event metadata synchronization.
tasks.notes: Static inspection of pinned source; no upstream code execution.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: NicoLiveHLSStream stores wsclient and selects NicoLiveHLSStreamReader (src/streamlink/plugins/nicolive.py:161-167). That reader sets wsclient.opened before opening HLS and closes the WebSocket client after HLS closes (src/streamlink/plugins/nicolive.py:146-158). This coordinates stream and WebSocket lifecycle. The shown class does not itself implement bidirectional per-segment synchronization or metadata updates.

checked_claims.claim: Union nested lookups recursive and any missing key raises
checked_claims.reason: Nested traversal iterative; missing final key returns default, intermediate key missing errors.

material_errors: Nested traversal iterative; missing final key returns default, intermediate key missing errors.
tasks.notes: Static inspection of pinned source; no upstream code execution.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: _validate_uniongetschema applies each getter independently to the same input and collects results using schema.seq (src/streamlink/validate/_validate.py:354-356). Nested traversal is an iterative loop inside _validate_getitemschema, indexing each path component (src/streamlink/validate/_validate.py:254-266). Missing intermediate components raise ValidationError, while a missing final component returns schema.default (src/streamlink/validate/_validate.py:267-276). Thus ordered lookups need not all succeed to produce results.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Extend the existing singledispatch validate(schema, value) mechanism with a handler for a distinct schema type (src/streamlink/validate/_validate.py:48-64). Preserve existing registrations, output transformations, and ValidationError behavior; Schema.validate wraps those failures into its configured exception (src/streamlink/validate/_validate.py:29-42). Verify mixed old/new chains, invalid inputs, defaults and exception text, and avoid changing dispatch for existing schema classes. Optional new types and targeted regression coverage provide compatibility without requiring a new base Validator or dynamic plugin system.
